title: High-frequency trading firms such as Jane Street are investing in AI and chip startups and neoclouds, and building data centers to gain an edge in the AI era (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: High-frequency trading firms such as Jane Street are investing in AI and chip startups and neoclouds, and building data centers to gain an edge in the AI era — High-frequency trading firms are even building their own data centers as they compete for an edge in the AI era.
